name: devlens-cli
description: Local repository graphs and dependency analysis

scripts.build: tsup cli/src/index.ts --format esm --platform node --target node20 --out-dir dist --no-splitting && pnpm --filter devlens build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.package: pnpm build && mkdir -p release && npm pack ./cli --pack-destination release
